# ContainerTransformExtensions

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Fluent mirroring and translation of native child content.

Namespace `BonniePDF.Fluent`.

## Methods

- [`FlipHorizontal`](#fliphorizontal): Mirror child content left to right inside its original box.
- [`FlipVertical`](#flipvertical): Mirror child content top to bottom inside its original box.
- [`Translate`](#translate): Move painted content right/down by signed point offsets without changing flow.
- [`TranslateX`](#translatex): Move painted content horizontally by a signed point offset.
- [`TranslateY`](#translatey): Move painted content vertically by a signed point offset.
